BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Fey, Johnson, Clibborn, Young, Griffey, Stanford, Jinkins, and Dent

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vehicle service fees; and amending RCW 46.17.040.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 46.17.040 and 2014 c 59 s 2 are each amended to read as follows:Service fees.
BillSection.P: (1) The department, county auditor or other agent, or subagent appointed by the director shall collect a service fee of:

(a) Twelve Eighteen dollars for changes in a certificate of title, with or without registration renewal, or for verification of record and preparation of an affidavit of lost title other than at the time of the certificate of title application or transfer; and
(b) Five Nine dollars for a registration renewal, issuing a transit permit, or any other service under this section.

(2) Service fees collected under this section by the department or county auditor or other agent appointed by the director must be credited to the capital vessel replacement account under RCW 47.60.322.
